summary: Iteration 77 — frontend-only E2E of the DayClose ('Chiusura Turno & Registro HACCP') new features on the public URL as admin@mikilab.de. Verified: mode toggle (dayclose-modeswitch / wizard / storico), Storico archive (empty state, item rendering, search by lotto + date + no-match), full 3-step wizard closure, celebration overlay with 'Scarica report PDF' + close, PDF generation (200 / application/pdf / %PDF- header, popup opened with blob URL), low-stock banner (dayclose-lowstock) triggered by qty<=threshold with a clickable 'Ordina al fornitore' (mailto) button, and full IT/DE rendering of both modes and all 3 steps. No page/JS errors. All test data (1 day_closure, 2 haccp_logs, 1 inventory_item for admin) deleted afterwards.

minor.issue: Called twice on cold load pre-login, producing 2 x 401 in the browser console (noise only, no functional impact).

ui_bugs.issue: Full-screen overlay (div.absolute.inset-0.bg-black/40 pointer-events-auto inside data-testid=lab-tour) re-appears every time 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' is opened and intercepts ALL pointer events, so capo-quicklink-dayclose (and every tool tile) is unclickable until the tour is dismissed. The dismiss controls ('Salta' / 'Avanti' / X) have NO data-testid, making automated dismissal fragile.

integration_issues.issue: downloadPdf() does window.open(blobUrl) AFTER an await (async fetch). In Chromium headless the popup did open and the endpoint returns a valid PDF (verified 200 / application/pdf / %PDF-, 2743 bytes), but an async window.open is commonly suppressed by popup blockers (Safari/iOS, Chrome strict settings) — the user then sees nothing and no error. Recommend an <a download="chiusura-<lotto>.pdf"> anchor click (or open the tab synchronously before the fetch) so the report always reaches the user with a meaningful filename.

issues: The 'soglia avviso' (threshold) input is squeezed between the warning icon and the row edge; with a value entered the number spinner sits half outside the field (see lowstock screenshot). Give the threshold input a min-width or move it to its own line.

action_items: Replace window.open(blobUrl) in DayClose.downloadPdf with an anchor-based download (filename e.g. chiusura-<lotto>.pdf) to avoid popup-blocker suppression; add a toast on success.
Add data-testid to LabTour controls (skip/next/close) and make the overlay non-blocking (or auto-dismiss once seen) — it currently blocks every click in 'Il Tuo Laboratorio'.
Cosmetic: fix cramped 'soglia avviso' input in the Magazzino row.
critical_code_review_comments: DayClose.jsx: doClose() does `await saveInventory().catch(()=>{})` — saveInventory already swallows its own errors and returns undefined, so .catch on undefined would throw if it ever rejected; more importantly a failed inventory save still lets the closure proceed and decrement stale server stock.
loadClosures() silently swallows errors (empty catch) — a failing /api/day-close/list renders the same 'Nessuna chiusura archiviata.' empty state as a genuinely empty archive; add an error state.
Storico list is only refreshed on clicking dayclose-mode-storico; after a closure created while already in storico mode the list would be stale (minor).
PREVIOUSLY REPORTED ISSUE APPEARS FIXED: only 2 haccp_logs were created for a closure with 1 temperature + cleaning (empty temperature rows no longer pollute the register).
